stories.title: Softwarepionier van eerste maanlanding Margaret Hamilton (90) overleden

en.title: Software pioneer of first moon landing Margaret Hamilton (90) deceased
en.summary: Margaret Hamilton, who contributed to the development of software engineering and wrote code that helped NASA Apollo astronauts land on the moon, died at age 90. Her former employer MIT announced her death.

stories.title: Margaret Hamilton (90) softwarepionier eerste maanlanding overleden

en.title: Margaret Hamilton (90) software pioneer of first moon landing deceased
en.summary: Margaret Hamilton, who developed software for Apollo 11's 1969 moon landing and enabled American success in the space race, died at age 90 on September 30. MIT, where she worked for many years, announced her death.

stories.title: Europese Rekenkamer waarschuwt voor snel stijgende EU schuldenlast

en.title: European Court of Auditors warns of rapidly rising EU debt burden
en.summary: The European Court of Auditors expressed concern over the EU's growing debt, which has reached 740 billion euros and is projected to grow to one trillion euros by 2027. The increase stems from Ukraine support, rising interest rates, defense spending, and the pandemic recovery fund.

stories.title: Pro-Palestijns protest Amsterdam ontbonden omdat betogers andere route namen

en.title: Pro-Palestinian protest Amsterdam dissolved because demonstrators took different route
en.summary: Amsterdam's mayor dissolved a pro-Palestinian demonstration after protesters deviated from the approved route. The protest included expressions of support for Hamas.

stories.title: Europese Rekenkamer waarschuwt voor schuldenberg EU: ‘Dat drukt andere uitgaven weg’

en.title: European Court of Auditors warns of EU debt burden: 'That crowds out other spending'
en.summary: The European Court of Auditors has issued a warning about the EU's growing debt levels, cautioning that high debt service obligations reduce funds available for other expenditures.

stories.title: Boegbeeld van Spaanse woningprotesten Maricarmen Abascal (87) overleden

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal (87), figurehead of Spanish housing protests, deceased
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked major housing protests in Spain, has died. Her case highlighted the country's severe housing crisis driven by inflation and insufficient affordable housing.

stories.title: Maricarmen (87), de vrouw die het symbool werd van de Spaanse wooncrisis, overleden

en.title: Maricarmen (87), the woman who became the symbol of Spain's housing crisis, deceased
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction became emblematic of Spain's housing crisis has passed away.

stories.title: Pro-Palestijns protest met Hamas-steunbetuigingen in Amsterdam ontbonden

en.title: Pro-Palestinian protest with Hamas support statements in Amsterdam dissolved
en.summary: Amsterdam's mayor disbanded a pro-Palestinian demonstration on Dam Square where participants displayed slogans supporting Hamas and burned an Israeli flag.

stories.title: Messi eert Maradona na afscheid Argentinië, Ronaldo reageert met 'dikke knuffel'

en.title: Messi honors Maradona following Argentina farewell, Ronaldo responds with 'big hug'
en.summary: Lionel Messi paid tribute to Diego Maradona on Instagram following his farewell to the Argentine national team. Cristiano Ronaldo was among prominent figures who responded to Messi's post.

stories.title: Spaanse vrouw (87) overleden die huis uit moest en politieke crisis ontketende

en.title: Spanish woman (87) deceased who was evicted and sparked political crisis
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, whose eviction recently triggered a major political crisis in Spain, has died at age 87. Her case drew widespread attention to the country's housing affordability challenges.

stories.title: Nieuw-Lekkerland op veel plekken beklad met hakenkruis in vlag Israël

en.title: Nieuw-Lekkerland defaced with swastikas in multiple locations
en.summary: Dozens of locations in Nieuw-Lekkerland, South Holland, have been vandalized with swastikas superimposed on Israeli flags painted with spray paint. The municipality has filed a report and is removing the graffiti.

stories.title: De mislukte executie van Christa Pike is in elk opzicht uniek, maar de vraag blijft waarom het misging

en.title: The failed execution of Christa Pike is unique in every respect, but the question remains why it went wrong
en.summary: An execution of Christa Pike failed in unusual circumstances, raising questions about what caused the failure.
